_meta.description_es: Matriz de arquitectura Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Aislamiento estricto de dominios, conectores abstractos y Secure Key Broker. Uso exclusivo de la IA. Aditivo y retrocompatible — no reemplaza ninguna regla previa.
_meta.description_en: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) architecture matrix. Strict domain isolation, abstract connectors and Secure Key Broker. AI use only. Additive and backward-compatible — does not replace any prior rule.
_meta.load_when_es: Al crear/modificar un dominio, conector o feature de negocio, o en chequeo de coherencia R16/R17.
_meta.load_when_en: When creating/modifying a domain, connector or business feature, or on R16/R17 coherence check.

domain_definition.note_es: Cada dominio es una unidad de negocio autónoma con su propio lenguaje ubicuo y reglas aisladas.
domain_definition.note_en: Each domain is an autonomous business unit with its own ubiquitous language and isolated rules.

rule_1_modular_residence.statement_es: Toda regla de negocio debe residir en un directorio de dominio único y modular.
rule_1_modular_residence.statement_en: Every business rule must reside within a unique, modular domain directory.

rule_2_async_inter_domain.statement_es: La comunicación entre dominios es estrictamente asíncrona vía Event-Driven o Conectores Abstractos.
rule_2_async_inter_domain.statement_en: Inter-domain communication is strictly asynchronous via Event-Driven or Abstract Connectors.

rule_3_no_foreign_state.statement_es: Ningún dominio accede directamente a la base de datos o memoria de otro dominio.
rule_3_no_foreign_state.statement_en: Never allow a domain to access the database or memory of another domain directly.

layers.domain: entities, value-objects, domain-events, business-rules (pure, no infra)
layers.infrastructure: connectors only (DB, API, env access lives here)

bounded_context_template.owns_storage: [schema / table prefix owned exclusively by this domain]

connectors.principle_es: Toda infraestructura, API y base de datos se abstrae detrás de un Conector. El dominio depende de la interfaz del conector, nunca de la implementación concreta.
connectors.principle_en: All infrastructure, APIs and databases are abstracted behind a Connector. The domain depends on the connector interface, never the concrete implementation.

connector_template.kind: [database / api / queue / cache / email / payment / storage]
connector_template.interface: [port name — typed contract consumed by the domain]

secure_key_broker.principle_es: Cero acceso directo a entorno. Ningún sub-agente o skill invoca process.env ni lee archivos de configuración crudos. Los secretos se inyectan en runtime a través de un Broker de Claves unificado.
secure_key_broker.principle_en: Zero direct env access. No sub-agent or skill may invoke process.env or read raw configuration files. Secrets are injected at runtime via a unified Secure Key Broker.
rules_es: Prohibido process.env fuera de la capa infrastructure/broker
Prohibido leer archivos *.env o *.private.json desde dominio o aplicación
El broker resuelve y entrega secretos tipados a los conectores en runtime
Los secretos nunca se loguean, serializan ni se incrustan en commits
rules_en: process.env forbidden outside the infrastructure/broker layer
Reading *.env or *.private.json from domain or application layers forbidden
The broker resolves and delivers typed secrets to connectors at runtime
Secrets are never logged, serialized or embedded in commits

broker_template.scope: [domain id that may request this key]

skills.principle_es: Las capacidades del dominio se exponen como Skills: funciones atómicas, tipadas y reutilizables. Mapeo 1:1 con los Casos de Uso del dominio.
skills.principle_en: Domain capabilities are exposed as Skills: atomic, typed and reusable functions. 1:1 mapping with domain Use Cases.

compatibility_contract_es: Mantener compatibilidad total con abstracciones, clases y tipos ya presentes en architect-ai-framework y architect-ai-modules. Crear dominios nuevos replicando el esqueleto de architect-ai-modules/templates.
compatibility_contract_en: Maintain full compatibility with existing abstractions, classes and types in architect-ai-framework and architect-ai-modules. Create new domains by replicating the architect-ai-modules/templates skeleton.
